cases.test: new tools have manifest discovery policy and exact descriptor ownership
invalid preferences do not partially change the theme
configuration mutations require foreground grown-up admission before any owner write
navigation has versioned operability and dispatches every exact assistant destination
settings persist and a new repository restores the same values
read and stop reach shared output and never claim playback complete
opening an internal page uses a bounded explicit intent and reports dispatch
first review outcome affects difficulty immediately
nothing is claimed before the first review
a card without history draws no curve
recall probability falls monotonically with time since the last review
the retention target moves the due date and never the measured mastery
an overdue card keeps its fall inside the window
a repeated success raises stability and mastery without bound drift
the curve covers the due date and stays inside the chart
a failed recall lowers stability compared with a successful one
the due date is where recall probability reaches the chosen target
an untouched card is not measured
a store that goes away still yields the default rather than crashing
a late mirror emission from before a selection never overwrites it
a failed write is reported and leaves the previous value in place
the controller mirrors what the store already holds
an unknown stored name falls back to the default
selecting a new intensity persists it and publishes it
a remembered card moves one rung up
a forgotten card drops one rung
the ladder never schedules in the past
two remembered cards in a row skip a rung
the last rung is mastered and kept on maintenance
the ladder ignores the memory model's retention target
two forgotten reviews reset the ladder
mode is opt in persisted and reversible
extended backgrounds persist independently without replacing old profile fields
unknown stored choices fall back to readable defaults
editing light before initial load preserves stored dark colours
apply acknowledges and restores both independent drafts
every colour and tone in both themes preserves body and action contrast
